verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents `humanlayer automation run`, which launches a Cloud-visible coding session from a CI job (docs-12), and it lets the agent open a draft pull request (docs-19). A team could wire a failing CI job to launch a fix session, but there is no documented built-in CI-failure diagnosis or auto-fix workflow. Draft PRs are also shown only as an interactive request from the GitHub tab or diff view. Missing for 10: a native trigger on CI failure, automatic failure diagnosis, an automated PR opened from automation sessions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
